messages:
sana: Drafting a Stability Gate for GA of multi-tier inference. Need fast thumbs from Docs, SRE, Billing, Support.

kevin: What lanes should we cover?

sana: Lanes: regression/safety, SLOs & fallback, telemetry & alerts, customer docs/runbooks, billing/quota. One owner per lane, simple pass/fail checks.

ivy: I can own docs. Deliverables: 1-page Quick Card, rollback steps, Dedicated/Private migration notes, escalation/contact table.

frank: Billing items: free-tier cap, committed vs burst pricing, preview credits, KV-cache billing note, and explicit 429 JSON payload for SDKs.

kevin: SLOs suggestion: p95 <= 350ms (short), p95 <= 700ms (long). Global error rate < 0.35%. Degrade rule: sustained p95 > 2x target for 15m -> automatic fallback to a compatible model variant.

deploy-bot: Auto-fallback requires a documented circuit-breaker and a tested rollback play (owner: eng-runtime).

sana: Telemetry must provide per-model token meter, cost-per-token burn chart, and trace -> request-id linkage. Alerts: SLO burn > 60% in 5m or error spike > 0.5% in 1m -> page on-call.

ivy: I'll publish the Quick Card and internal runbook by EOD and attach to the entrance checklist.

frank: Ops constraint: free-tier QPS capped at 10 qps/account with clear throttle message + billing link. Dedicated trial requires an overage clause and manual approval flow for temporary bumps.

kevin: Support plan: Tier-1 CS playbook plus a staffed 72-hour critical rota after launch. Owner pairing: eng-platform + eng-sre.

sana: Proposed gate to flip beta -> GA: (1) all checklist lanes green, (2) regression smoke pass (3k prompts across key intents), (3) SRE load test at 2x expected traffic for 30m meeting p95 targets, (4) pricing page + billing link live, (5) 72-hour rota staffed.

kevin: Non-negotiable: automated fallback and rollback must be tested end-to-end; no manual-only emergency paths.

ivy: Docs non-negotiable: runbook with explicit escalation matrix and primary/secondary contacts.

frank: Billing non-negotiable: Dedicated trial overage policy signed off by finance before GA.

sana: I'll compile a one-page Stability Gate doc with owners and upload to the launch tracker. Reconvene tomorrow 10:00 for final go/no-go. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window scheduled 2025-05-22 02:00 UTC  confirm rota if go.
